blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Small base language models have improved mostly by reading ever more tokens, and recent models with only a few billion parameters are trained on more than ten trillion of them ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Hugging Face, 2025c ) .
Because high-quality English text is limited, a growing budget also ends up repeating the same data, with diminishing returns ( Muennighoff et al., 2025a ) .
Rather than reading the same English text again and again, we suggest that a small model should spend part of its budget on the text it has seen least: text in other languages.
blocks.zh:
小型基本语言模型大多通过阅读更多的标语得到改善,最近只有数十亿参数的模型接受了超过10万亿参数的培训(Yang等人,2025a); (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). Hugging Face, 2025c.
因为高品质 英文文本有限,不断增长的预算也导致重复同样的数据,回报率不断下降(Muennighoff等人,2025a)。 。 。 。
我们建议,与其一次又一次地读同一份英文文本,不如把预算的一部分用在它所看到的最少的案文上:其他语文文本。

blocks.en:
Text in other languages may offer more than new tokens.
Research on multi-task learning has shown that related tasks can improve generalization by sharing learned representations ( Caruana, 1997 ) .
Similarly, multilingual neural machine translation has demonstrated positive transfer between languages ( Firat et al., 2016 ) .
More broadly, representation learning suggests that different observations can help a model discover shared explanatory factors underlying the data ( Bengio et al., 2013 ) .
These findings motivate a hypothesis: different languages may provide complementary perspectives on the same underlying reality, helping a shared model learn more generalizable representations.
Such benefits could potentially extend beyond multilingual tasks to English reasoning and other capabilities.
blocks.zh:
其他语言的文本可能提供比新符号更多的.
关于多任务学习的研究表明,通过分享学到的表述,相关任务可以改进概括性(Caruana,1997年)。
同样,多语种神经机理翻译也显示出了语言之间的正向转移(Firat等人,2016年).
更广泛地说,代表性学习表明,不同的观测可以帮助模型发现数据背后的共同解释因素(Bengio等人,2013年)。
这些结论激发了一种假设:不同语言可能就同一基本现实提供补充观点,帮助共同模式学习更加笼统的表述。
这种好处可能超越多种语文的任务,扩大到英语推理和其他能力。

blocks.en:
Even counting second-language speakers, English has only about 1.5 billion speakers: most of the world’s population does not speak it ( Eberhard et al., 2025 ) .
Text in these languages is also widely available in open corpora ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Penedo et al., 2025 ; Oepen et al., 2026 ) .
Yet the general-purpose open base models that disclose their mixture contribute at most 12% of their tokens to this text ( Table 1 ).
Models built for European languages give it 21% to 51%, but in our evaluation they score far below general-purpose models of the same size.
For example, EuroLLM-1.7B and Apertus-v1.1-1.5B reach an average benchmark score of 27.6 and 31.2, against 53.8 for Qwen3-1.7B ( Table 18 ).
At first glance, these scores suggest that multilingual data cost a small model its general ability.
blocks.zh:
即使算起第二语言的讲者,英语的讲者也只有大约15亿:世界上大多数人口不讲英语(Eberhard等人,2025年)。
这些语言的文字也广泛以开放的corpora形式提供(Nguyen等人,2024年;Penedo等人,2025年;Oepen等人,2026年)。
然而,披露其混合物的普通用途开放基模型最多占其标志值的12%(表1)。
为欧洲语言构建的模型给出了21%到51%,但是在我们的评价中,它们的得分远低于同样大小的通用模型.
例如,欧洲LLM-1.7B和Apertus-v1.1-1.5B 达到平均基准分27.6和31.2,而Qune3-1.7B为53.8(表18)。
乍一看,这些分数表明,多语种数据花费了一个小模型的一般能力。

blocks.en:
This leaves an open question: can a model with a small active-parameter budget be strong across many languages without sacrificing its English?
Earlier work found that languages compete for the capacity of a small model, so adding languages can hurt each language ( Conneau et al., 2020 ; Chang et al., 2024 ) .
Recent scaling laws show that this trade-off depends on the size of the model and on how data are allocated across languages ( Longpre et al., 2026 ) .
The answer, therefore, depends not only on how much multilingual data a model is trained on but also on how it is chosen and used.
blocks.zh:
这留下了一个尚未解决的问题:一个具有少量活动参数预算的模型能否在不牺牲其英语的情况下在多种语言中强大?
早期的作品发现语言竞相获得一个小模型的能力,所以添加语言可以伤害到每一个语言(Conneau等人,2020年;Chang等人,2024年).
近期的缩放定律表明,这种权衡取决于模型的大小以及不同语言之间如何分配数据(Longpre等人,2026年)。
因此,答案不仅取决于对一个模型进行多少多语种数据的培训,而且还取决于如何选择和使用该模型。

blocks.en:
We address this question with Lara Mini base , a multilingual mixture of experts base model with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters, pretrained from scratch on 6T tokens.
We built Lara Mini base around its data.
From openly released datasets, we assembled a deduplicated and filtered pool in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union.
The first three training stages (main, transition and anneal) read 6T tokens from this pool and move toward high-quality, question-answer, code and math data.
English makes up only 41% of the 6T tokens.
English falls from 44% of the main stage to 27% of the anneal, so that the other languages grow from 46% to 55% of the text and outweigh English in the anneal ( Section 2 ).
Of the 6T training tokens, 97% are the first read of a document ( Section 2.3 ).
A fourth and last stage of 100B tokens then extends the context of Lara Mini base to 128k tokens ( Section 4.1 ).
To support many languages while keeping inference cost low, every layer of Lara Mini base has a fine-grained mixture of experts that activates 4 of 128 experts per token.
To keep the inference state small, the layers interleave Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , sliding-window and global attention, the latter in only 7 of the 34 layers ( Section 3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们用Lara Mini碱基来解决这个问题。 Lara Mini碱基是一个多语种的专家碱基模型混合体,总参数为7.2B,活性参数为0.6B,从头开始在6T符号上预先训练。
我们建立了Laramini数据库 围绕它的数据。
从公开发布的数据集中,我们用英语和44种其他语言组装了一个被破译和过滤的集合,它们共同涵盖欧洲联盟的所有24种正式语文。
前三个培训阶段(主、过渡和肛门)从这个集合读取6T令牌,转向高质量、问答、代码和数学数据。
英语只占6T标志的41%.
英语从主舞台的44%下降到肛门的27%,因此其他语言的文本从46%上升到55%,在肛门中超过了英语(第2节)。
在6T培训标志中,97%是第一次阅读文件(第2.3节)。
100B令牌的第四个也是最后一个阶段,然后将Lara Mini基础的上下文扩大到128k令牌(第4.1节)。
为了支持许多语言,同时保持推论成本低廉,Lara Mini基础的每层都有精细的混合型专家,每节标语激活128位专家中的4位.
为了保持推论状态小,各层间断Gated DeltaNet(Yang等人,2025c),滑窗和全球关注,后者在34层中只有7层(第3节).

blocks.en:
We compare Lara Mini base with 56 open base models on standard English, multilingual, math and code benchmarks, all evaluated by us with the same harness and settings.
As in Muennighoff et al. (2025b) , we group the models by active parameters, as a rough approximation of inference cost ( Section 5.1 ).
Among the 36 models with up to 2B active parameters, Lara Mini base ranks first on the average of the four domains, with 57.0, 3.1 points above the next model ( Figure 1 ).
It also ranks first on the multilingual average in the languages it supports, 3.4 points ahead.
It leads even though this group includes models with more than 3 times its active parameters.
The next two models, granite-4.0-h-tiny and Qwen3-1.7B, were trained on 22.5T and 36T tokens, about 4 and 6 times as many ( Table 6 ). Lara Mini base also outscores several models with 6 to 13 times its active parameters, such as Ministral-3-3B (53.8), Gemma-4-E4B (55.4) and Llama-3.1-8B (51.2).
Among the models we evaluated from European developers, it is the strongest, ahead of Apertus-v1.5-8B (55.8) and Domyn-Edge (55.4).
Although English accounts for less than half of its training data, Lara Mini base ranks second in its group for English.
When the multilingual third of the anneal is replaced with English, the English average rises by only 0.3 points and the multilingual average falls by 2.7 ( Section 6.1 ).
An expert routing analysis reveals that experts are shared across languages, which is consistent with this ablation hardly deteriorating performance on English tasks ( Section 6.2 ).

我们比较了Lara Mini基础与56个基于标准英语,多语种,数学和代码基准的开放基础模型,这些模型都由我们用同样的绳索和设置来评价.
与Muennighoff等人(2025b)一样,我们将模型按活性参数分类,作为推论成本的粗略近似值(第5.1节)。
在最多有2B活性参数的36个模型中,Lara Mini碱基在4个域的平均值中位居第一,比下一个模型高57.0,3.1分(图1).
它还在它所支持的语言中,在多语种平均排名中位居第一,领先3.4分.
尽管这个组包括了超过3倍于其有效参数的模型,但它还是领先.
接下来的两种型号,花岗岩4.0-h-tiny和Quen3-1.7B,分别接受了22.5T和36T令牌的培训,大约是4和6倍(表6). 拉腊 迷你碱基还比几个具有6至13倍有效参数的型号多,如Ministry-3-3B(53.8),Gemma-4-E4B(55.4)和Llama-3.1-8B(51.2).
在我们从欧洲开发商评价的模型中,它是最强的,领先于Apertus-v1.5-8B(55.8)和Domyn-Edge(55.4).
虽然英语只占其培训数据的一半以下,但Lara Mini基地在英语组中排名第二.
当多语种三分之一的肛门被英语取代时,英语平均只上升0.3分,多语种平均下降2.7分(第6.1节.
专家路线分析显示,专家在各语文之间共享,这与英语任务业绩几乎恶化的情况是一致的(第6.2节)。

blocks.en:
These results come at a small inference cost. Lara Mini base needs the compute per token of a small dense model, although all its parameters must be held in memory.
For a single user on one A100 GPU, without quantization, it generates about 1,100 characters per second ( Figure 5 ).
This speed matches that of dense models with about 1B parameters and is at least 1.8 times that of every model that scores higher on average.
blocks.zh:
这些结果的代价很小。 拉腊 迷你碱基需要一个小稠密模型的每个符号的计算,尽管其所有参数必须保存在内存中.
对于一个A100GPU上的单个用户,不进行量化,每秒生成约1100个字符(图5).
这种速度与密集模型的大约1B参数相匹配,至少是平均得分较高的每个模型的1.8倍.

blocks.zh: 2 预训数据

blocks.en:
Unlike general-purpose models, Lara Mini base is not trained mostly on English: English accounts for only 41% of its 6T training tokens. 2 2 2 The English domain of Table 2 . Code, math and SFT-like data, mostly in English, are counted as separate domains. The 44 other languages account for at least three times the share of general-purpose open base models that disclose them ( Table 1 ).
In absolute terms, Lara Mini base processes more multilingual tokens than Llama 3, SmolLM3, or Nemotron Nano 2, even though they train on 11.2T to 20T tokens.
Its share is within the range of the models for European languages in Table 1 , all of which have at least 1.7B active parameters, against 0.6B for Lara Mini base .
Smaller multilingual models exist, such as EuroMoE-2.6B-A0.6B and Apertus-v1.1-0.5B, but score far below Lara Mini base ( Table 18 ).

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Sources
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en:
Besides web, PDF and Wikipedia text ( Table 2 ), 26% of the training tokens (1.58T) are synthetic, most of them from NVIDIA’s Nemotron collections.
The largest part is English web text rewritten by language models; the rest is code, math, SFT-like data (examples in the format of supervised fine-tuning data) and multilingual question-answer data.
The multilingual question-answer data make up 13% of the multilingual tokens and are mostly machine-translated from English into 16 of our languages. Appendix A lists every data group with its sources and licenses ( Table 9 ) and shows how deduplication and selection reduce the collected data to the pool ( Figure 8 ).

blocks.en: 2.2 Deduplication and Filtering
blocks.zh: 2.2 复制和过滤

blocks.en:
We remove exact copies over the whole pool at once, so that a text kept from one source is removed from every other.
We then remove near-duplicates with the MinHash ( Broder, 1997 ; Lee et al., 2022 ) implementation of Marin ( Marin Community, 2025 ) , within each language across all its sources, and within code.
Synthetic and rewritten data are not compared for near-duplicates with the pages they rephrase.
Deduplication keeps about 30T of the 50T collected tokens.
Most duplicates occur across sources, so per-source deduplication would miss them: FineWeb-Edu, for instance, keeps only 15% of its tokens after deduplication against the other sources.
blocks.zh:
我们马上把整个水池的复制件删除 这样从一个来源保存的文本就会从另一个来源删除
然后,我们将MinHash(Broder,1997年;Lee等人,2022年)执行Marin(Marin Community,2025年)的近似重复删除,在每种语言中,在其所有来源和代码中。
合成和重写数据不与它们重写的页面作近似重复的比较。
复制保留了50T收集的代币中约30T.
大多数重复发生在不同来源之间,因此每个来源的去除会错过它们:例如,FineWeb-Edu在与其他来源的去除后只保留15%的代币.

blocks.en:
For quality, we use the model-based quality signals released with the main corpora.
In English web data, high quality means the two highest classes of Nemotron-CC and FineWeb-Edu.
The medium class of Nemotron-CC is used only before the anneal.
In multilingual web data, high quality means FineWeb2-HQ, the pages that a model-based filter ranks highest in each language.
Math is split in the same way by the quality tiers of its sources.
On top of these signals, Translated’s internal pipeline applies further filters of its own, built on the company’s experience with multilingual data.
blocks.zh:
对于质量,我们使用与主蝎子一起发布的基于模型的质量信号.
在英语网络数据中,高质量是指Nemotron-CC和FineWeb-Edu两个最高的类别.
中类的Nemotron-CC只在肛门之前使用.
在多语种网络数据中,高质量是指FineWeb2-HQ,基于模型的过滤器在每种语言中排名最高的页面.
数学以同样的方式被其来源的质量等级划分.
除了这些信号之外,Translated的内部管道还进一步使用了自己的过滤器,这些过滤器建立在该公司掌握多语言数据的经验之上。

blocks.en:
The selected data, tokenized with the Qwen3 tokenizer, form the training pool ( Table 10 ).
Besides all the high-quality data, the pool holds more plain web text (web data below the high-quality level) than training needs.
Training reads only about a fifth of this plain web text.
blocks.zh:
与 Quen3 符号化的选定数据构成培训池(表10)。
除了所有高质量的数据外,该集合还持有比培训需要更简单的网络文本(网络数据低于高质量水平).
培训只读了大约五分之一的网络文本。

blocks.en:
We scanned the whole training pool for the items of our evaluation benchmarks.
The scan follows Brown et al. (2020) : it matches long word n-grams (character n-grams in scripts written without spaces) and flags the documents that share a large part of a benchmark item.
Flagged documents make up about 0.03% of the pool’s tokens.
Benchmarks whose items circulate widely on the web, mostly in English, math and code, are the most exposed, while the benchmarks of our multilingual domain are much less so.
Of the first three stages, only the anneal is decontaminated, as in Kolibri ( Aleph Alpha, 2026 ) : it skips training sequences that contain a flagged document without changing the mixture.
The tests in Section D.4 show no evidence that Lara Mini base memorized the contaminated items: its scores are consistent with generalization and not inflated by contamination.
blocks.zh:
我们为评价基准项目扫描了整个培训人才库。
扫描跟随Brown等人(2020年):它匹配长词n-gram(在没有空格的情况下写成的脚本中的字符n-gram),并标出共享大部分基准项的文档.
标志性文件占游泳池标志的0.03%。
其项目在网络上广泛流通的基准,大部分是英文、数学和代码,最容易曝光,而我们多语种领域的基准则少得多。
在前三个阶段中,只有肛门被解毒,如Kolibri(Aleph Alph, 2026)中:它跳过含有标注文档的训练序列而不改变混合物.
D.4节中的试验没有证据表明Lara Mini基地已记住受污染的物品:其分数与一般情况一致,不会因污染而膨胀。

blocks.en: 2.3 Data Mixture and Curriculum
blocks.zh: 2.3 数据混合和课程设置

blocks.en:
We designed the mixture to achieve competence in 44 languages besides English, with priority given to the official EU languages.
It also had to keep English knowledge and reasoning on par with English-centric models of the same size, while adding basic code and math abilities.
We set it with explicit rules rather than by optimizing mixture weights on proxy models.
Each rule rests on published evidence, data availability, or our priorities among languages ( Table 3 ). Figure 2 shows the resulting mixture of each stage.
blocks.zh:
我们设计这种混合语言是为了在英语之外实现44种语言的能力,优先考虑欧盟的官方语言。
它还必须使英语知识和推理与同样大小的以英语为中心的模型保持同等水平,同时增加基本的代码和数学能力.
我们设定了明确的规则,而不是优化代理模型的混合权重。
每项规则都以已公布的证据、数据提供情况或我们语文间的优先次序为依据(表3)。 图2显示每个阶段产生的混合物。

blocks.en:
Of the four stages of pretraining, the first three read 6T tokens in 4,096-token sequences.
The main stage, 4.8T tokens at constant learning rate, uses the broadest mixture.
The transition stage, with 0.6T tokens still at a constant learning rate, moves the mixture halfway toward the anneal mixture.
The anneal of the last 0.6T tokens decays the learning rate to zero.
As in earlier work, the learning rate decays only at the end ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Hägele et al., 2024 ) and training ends on high-quality data ( Feng et al., 2024 ) .
A sudden change in data can cause a model to forget what it learned earlier, and keeping part of the earlier mixture reduces this forgetting ( Ibrahim et al., 2024 ) .
The transition stage therefore splits the change into two smaller steps, as the two-blend schedule of Parmar et al. (2024) does in continued pretraining.
Over the three stages, code, math and SFT-like data grow from 19% to 40% of the tokens, and the anneal keeps only high-quality English web data.
The multilingual share stays at about a third while English falls from 44% to 27%, so that in the anneal multilingual text is the largest domain, ahead of English ( Figure 2 ).
Of the text in English and the other languages, without code, math and SFT-like data, the other languages make up 46% in the main stage, 50% in the transition and 55% in the anneal.
Its content also shifts toward high-quality sources: plain web text falls from 41% of the multilingual tokens to 6.5%, while high-quality web and question-answer data rise from 39% to 69%.
blocks.zh:
在预训的四个阶段中,前三个在4,096个托肯序列中读取6T令牌.
主舞台4.8T符号以恒定的学习速度使用最宽的混合物.
过渡阶段的0.6T符号仍然处于恒定的学习速率,使混合物半途向肛门混合物移动。
最后0.6T令牌的肛门将学习速率衰减为零.
与早期的工作一样,学习率只在结尾衰减(Hu等人,2024年;Hägelle等人,2024年),培训在高质量的数据上结束(Feng等人,2024年)。
数据突然变化会导致一个模型忘记它先前学到的东西,保留一部分早期的混合物会减少这种遗忘(Ibrahim等人,2024年).
因此,过渡阶段将改变分为两个较小的步骤,正如帕尔马尔等人(2024年)在继续预训中的两块板块时间表那样。
在三个阶段中,代码,数学和类似SFT的数据从占符数的19%增长到40%,肛门只保留高质量的英语网络数据.
多语种份额保持在三分之一左右,而英语则从44%下降到27%,因此在肛门多语种文本中是最大的域名,领先于英语(图2)。
在英语和其他语言的文本中,没有代码,数学和SFT类数据,其他语言在主阶段占46%,在过渡阶段占50%,在肛门占55%.
其内容也转向高质量的来源:纯网络文本从41%的多语种符号下降到6.5%,而高质量的网络和问答数据则从39%上升到69%.

blocks.en:
We include every language with at least 20B tokens after deduplication.
Irish and Maltese have far fewer speakers, but we include them so that all 24 official languages of the European Union are covered.
This gives 44 languages besides English ( Table 11 ).
Sampling languages by size would give Russian and Chinese a third of the multilingual tokens.
Flatter sampling trades quality in high-resource languages for quality in low-resource ones ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) .
We therefore sample languages more evenly than by size, with extra weight given to the official EU languages and to a selection of widely spoken languages outside the EU.
Compared with size-based sampling, these weights raise the share of official EU languages from 46% to 61% of multilingual tokens, mostly at the expense of Russian, Chinese and Japanese ( Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh:
我们包括每一种在分解后至少有20B符号的语言.
爱尔兰语和马耳他语的发言者少得多,但我们把发言者包括在内,以便涵盖欧洲联盟所有24种正式语文。
除了英语之外,还有44种语言(表11)。
按体积对语言进行取样,将使俄语和中文占多语种符号的三分之一。
Flatter采样以高资源语言进行质量交易,以低资源语言进行质量交易(Conneau等人,2020年)。
因此,我们比按规模比较均衡地抽取各种语言,对欧盟官方语言和欧盟以外一些广泛使用的语言给予额外重视。
与基于尺寸的抽样相比,这些权重将欧盟官方语言在多语种标志品中的比例从46%提高到61%,其中大部分是牺牲了俄语,中文和日语(图9).

blocks.en:
Because mixtures of experts are sensitive to repeated data ( Jha et al., 2026 ) , we cap the epochs of each source within the 6T budget, as in UniMax ( Chung et al., 2023 ) .
No source is read more than twice except Wikipedia, and plain web text is repeated only in Irish and Maltese.
In all, 97% of the training tokens are the first read of a document ( Table 10 ).
blocks.zh:
由于专家的混合物对重复数据很敏感(Jha等人,2026年),我们把每个来源的时代限制在6T预算范围内,如UniMax(Chung等人,2023年).
除了维基百科之外,没有任何来源读数超过两次,纯网络文本只在爱尔兰语和马耳他语中重复.
总共97%的培训标志是文件的首次阅读(表10)。

blocks.en:
The fourth stage reads 100B tokens in two steps: 40B in 32k-token sequences, then 60B in 128k-token sequences ( Section 4.1 ).
As in Kolibri ( Aleph Alpha, 2026 ) , both steps mix the anneal mixture as is, the same mixture reweighted toward long documents, and natural long documents from FinePDFs ( Hugging Face, 2025a ) and, in the 32k step only, FineWeb2-HQ ( Messmer et al., 2025 ) ( Table 12 ).
Both steps also give about 11% of their tokens to math and code: Nemotron-CC-Math documents of up to 16k tokens ( Karimi Mahabadi et al., 2026 ) , real (not synthetic) code and, in the 32k step only, SFT-like math documents of 16k to 32k tokens ( Table 9 ).
Keeping the anneal mixture limits the loss of short-context quality ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Team Olmo, 2025 ) .
It therefore makes up half of the 128k step, which ends training.
Across the whole stage, 58% of tokens come from documents longer than 4k tokens, and 12.3B tokens come from documents of at least 128k tokens.
blocks.zh:
第四阶段分两步读取100B令牌:32k-token序列中的40B,然后是128k-token序列中的60B(第4.1节).
与Kolibri(Aleph Alpha, 2026年)一样,两步骤都将肛门混合物和FinePDFs(Hugging Face, 2025年a)的天然长文件混合在一起,
这两个步骤还给数学和代码提供了大约11%的代号:Nemotron-CC-Math文件最多16k代号(Karimi Mahabadi等人,2026年),真实(不是合成)代号,仅32k步骤中,类似SFT的数学文件为16k到32k代号(表9).
保持肛门混合物限制了短体质量的损失(Gao等人,2025年;Team Olmo,2025年)。
因此,它占了结束培训的128k步骤的一半。
在整个阶段,58%的令牌来自超过4k令牌的文档,12.3B令牌来自至少128k令牌的文档.

blocks.en: 3 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3 建筑

blocks.en:
The architecture of Lara Mini base follows two goals: capacity for many languages at a small active budget, and a small inference state.
The mixture of experts (MoE) layers serve the first: in our small-scale comparisons, a fine-grained MoE outperformed dense models with more than twice its active parameters ( Section C.1 ).
The hybrid token mixing serves the second.
Only 7 of the 34 layers use global attention, so the memory held per sequence grows with context length about five times more slowly than in a full-attention model of the same shape.
blocks.zh:
Lara Mini基础的架构遵循两个目标:一个是许多语言在少量积极预算下的能力,另一个是小推论状态.
专家的混合层服务于第一层:在我们小规模的比较中,精密的MOE比其有效参数的两倍多的密集模型(C.1节)。
混合符牌混合为第二位服务.
34层中只有7层使用全局关注,因此每个序列所持有的内存与上下文长度的生长速度大约是同一形状的全心全意模型的5倍.

blocks.en:
Lara Mini base is a decoder-only Transformer with an MoE feed-forward block in every layer and three kinds of token mixer: Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , sliding-window attention and global attention.
It has 7.2B parameters in total, of which 0.6B are active for each token ( Table 4 ).
The routed experts hold 94% of all parameters (6.8B).
Of the active parameters, 24% are the tied input and output embedding, 41% the four routed experts and the shared expert that each token passes through, and 35% the token mixers, routers and normalization weights.
The remaining building blocks are standard: pre-normalization with RMSNorm ( Zhang and Sennrich, 2019 ) , SwiGLU feed-forward networks ( Shazeer, 2020 ) and no bias terms.
The model uses the Qwen3 tokenizer ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , with a vocabulary of 151,669 tokens (151,936 rows in the embedding table, padded). Figure 3 shows one layer and the order of the token mixers.
blocks.zh:
Lara Mini碱基是一款只有解码器的变形器,每层都有MOE的饲料前置块和三种令牌搅拌器: Gated DeltaNet(杨等人,2025c),滑窗关注和全球关注.
它共有7.2B参数,其中0.6B为每个符号的活性参数(表4)。
路由专家持有所有参数的94%(6.8B).
在有效参数中,24%为捆绑输入和输出嵌入,41%为4位路由专家和每个路由经过的共享专家,35%为路由器和正常化权重.
其余构件为标准:与RMSNorm(张和森恩里希,2019年),SwiGLU饲料前进网络(Shazeer,2020年)的预常态化,没有偏差条款.
该型号采用Qune3的标注剂(Yang et al., 2025a),其词汇为151,669个标注(151,936行在嵌入表中,加词). 图3显示一个层和符号搅拌器的顺序。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Architecture of Lara Mini base . Center: each of the 34 layers applies a token mixer and a mixture of experts block, each preceded by RMSNorm and wrapped in a residual connection. Left: the three token mixers and their order: four layers [Gated DeltaNet, sliding window, Gated DeltaNet, global] followed by six blocks of five [sliding window, Gated DeltaNet, sliding window, Gated DeltaNet, global], so that the last layer is global. Right: the mixture of experts block, with 4 of the 128 routed experts active per token and one shared expert.
blocks.zh: 图3:Lara Mini基地的建筑 中心:34层的每层都应用一个符号搅拌器和专家块的混合物,每层前方为RMSNorm,并用剩余连接包裹. 左方:三个令牌搅拌器及其顺序: 四层[Gated DeltaNet,滑动窗口,Gated DeltaNet,环球],后面是六个块五个[滑动窗口,Gated DeltaNet,滑动窗口,Gated DeltaNet,环球],因此最后一个层是环球的. 右:专家的混合挡板,128位路由专家中有4位活跃于每个符牌,1位共享专家.

blocks.en: 3.1 Hybrid Token Mixing
blocks.zh: 3.1 混合托肯混合

blocks.en:
A Transformer with global attention in every layer caches the keys and values of all previous tokens.
Its memory per sequence therefore grows linearly with context length and dominates the cost of serving long contexts. Lara Mini base instead interleaves three token mixers with complementary strengths, in short blocks, each ending with a global layer ( Figure 3 ).
A sliding-window layer is exact but sees only the last 512 tokens.
A Gated DeltaNet layer captures the full context via a compressed state but struggles with precise local comparisons ( Arora et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) .
Earlier hybrids therefore pair recurrent layers with local attention ( De et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ) .
The global layers enable exact retrieval at any distance, whereas the other two’s memory does not grow with context.
Gated DeltaNet can also make training more efficient: hybrids that use it in most layers match the quality of Transformers with substantially fewer training tokens ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
每个层都有全局关注的变形器会缓存所有之前的符号的键和值.
因此,其每个序列的内存随着上下文长度的线性增长,并主导服务长背景的成本. 拉腊 迷你碱基相反是三套具有互补优势的符号搅拌器,以短块形式,每块以一个全球层结尾(图3 )。
一个滑动的窗口层是准确的,但只看到最后512个符号.
一个三角洲 网层通过压缩状态捕捉到全部上下文,但与精确的局部比较有斗争(Arora等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年).
因此,早期的杂交种将重复层与局部的注意相配(De等人,2024年;Ren等人,2025年)。
全球地层可以在任何距离上进行精确的检索,而其他两个地层的内存却不会随上下文而增加。
三角洲 Net还可以提高培训效率:在大多数层次使用它的混合体与变形金刚石的质量相匹配,培训代币则要少得多(Merrill等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025c ) is a linear-attention layer whose state is a fixed-size matrix per head, updated with the gated delta rule: 𝐒 t = α t ​ 𝐒 t − 1 ​ ( 𝐈 − β t ​ 𝐤 t ​ 𝐤 t ⊤ ) + β t ​ 𝐯 t ​ 𝐤 t ⊤ , 𝐨 t = 𝐒 t ​ 𝐪 t . \mathbf{S}_{t}=\alpha_{t}\,\mathbf{S}_{t-1}\left(\mathbf{I}-\beta_{t}\,\mathbf{k}_{t}\mathbf{k}_{t}^{\top}\right)+\beta_{t}\,\mathbf{v}_{t}\mathbf{k}_{t}^{\top},\qquad\mathbf{o}_{t}=\mathbf{S}_{t}\,\mathbf{q}_{t}. (1) The decay α t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha_{t}\in(0,1) and the write strength β t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \beta_{t}\in(0,1) depend on the input token and are computed per head.
The decay lets a head forget, and the delta rule ( Schlag et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) overwrites the value stored under a key instead of adding to it.
Queries, keys and values pass through a causal depthwise convolution of width 4 followed by SiLU, and queries and keys are then L2-normalized.
The output of each head is normalized with RMSNorm and gated with SiLU.
The layer has no positional encoding: the recurrence itself carries the order of the tokens.

衰变让一个头忘记,三角洲规则(Schlag等人,2021年;Yang等人,2024年)覆盖了存储在密钥下的价值,而不是加入其中.
查询,密钥和值通过宽度4的因果深度演化,然后是SiLU,然后查询和密钥被L2-正常化.
每个头部的输出都与RMSNorm实现正常化,并用SiLU进行闸门.
该层没有位置编码:重现本身带有符的顺序.

blocks.en:
Sliding-window attention ( Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) restricts the attention of each token to the 512 most recent tokens, including itself.
These layers use rotary position embeddings with base 10,000 over the full head dimension.
blocks.zh:
滑动窗口的注意力 (贝尔塔吉等人, 2020; Jiang et al., 2023)将每个符号的注意力限制在包括自身在内的512个最新符号上.
这些层采用旋转位置嵌入,在全头维上方有1万个基座.

blocks.en:
The global layers attend over the whole context and use no positional encoding ( Kazemnejad et al., 2023 ) , since the Gated DeltaNet and sliding-window layers below them already encode position.
All attention layers, windowed and global, use grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) with 16 query and 4 key-value heads of dimension 128, and QK-norm.
blocks.zh:
全球层覆盖整个背景,没有使用位置编码(Kazemnejad等人,2023年),因为Gated DeltaNet和下面的滑动窗层已经编码了位置。
所有注意层,视窗和全局,都使用分组-query注意(Ainslie等人,2023年),有16个查询和4个键值头的尺寸128,以及QK-Norm.

blocks.en:
We compared the token mixers in ablations at 100B tokens against a baseline with global attention in every layer ( Section C.2 ).
The hybrid achieved a lower held-out loss than the baseline, very close to that of a variant with Gated DeltaNet in all 26 non-global layers, whereas sliding windows alone did not lower it.
The hybrid also had the largest mean benchmark gain over the baseline, matching an oracle that, for each benchmark, selects the better of the Gated DeltaNet and sliding-window variants.
After a context extension to 32k tokens, the hybrid was also the best variant on RULER and ONERULER at that length, 4 to 8 points above both single-mixer variants ( Table 16 ).
As computed from the architecture, the memory used per sequence during generation is 468 MiB at 32k tokens and 1.77 GiB at 128k tokens.
A model of the same shape with global attention in every layer would hold 2.13 GiB and 8.50 GiB.
blocks.zh:
我们用100B的符号与基线来比对象征性的搅拌器,每一层都有全球的关注(C.2节)。
混合体实现了低于基线的搁置损失,与Gated DeltaNet在全部26个非全球层中的变体非常接近,而单靠滑动窗口并不能降低其水平。
混合型还比基线获得最大的平均基准收益,匹配了对每个基准来说选择Gated DeltaNet和滑窗变体较好的预告片。
在上下文扩展至32k令牌后,该杂交也是RULAR和ONERULER在该长度上最好的变体,比两个单杂交变体都高出4到8分(表16).
从架构中计算出来,每代人使用的内存为:32k符的468 MiB,128k符的1.77 GiB.
每个层都有全球关注的相同形状的模型将持有2.13 GiB和8.50 GiB.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mixture of Experts Layers
blocks.zh: 3.2 专家层混合

blocks.en:
Every layer of Lara Mini base has an MoE block with 128 routed experts and 1 shared expert ( Dai et al., 2024 ) , all of which are SwiGLU networks with a hidden size of 512.
A linear router computes one logit per routed expert, in fp32.
Each token is routed to its top-4 experts by router logit, and their outputs are weighted by a softmax over these 4 logits.
The shared expert processes every token and its output is added without a gate.
Routing is dropless ( Gale et al., 2023 ) : no expert has a capacity limit, and no token is dropped.
A load-balancing loss ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) with coefficient 10 − 3 10^{-3} pushes the router toward an even distribution of expert use.
The experts are fine-grained: their hidden size is half the model width, and a token activates 1 / 32 1/32 of the routed parameters.
We chose the number of experts and this sparsity through ablations ( Section C.1 ). Section 6.2 analyzes how the trained model shares its experts across languages.
blocks.zh:
Lara Mini基地的每层都有一个MOE块,有128位路由专家和1位共享专家(Dai等人,2024年),这些都是SwiGLU网络,隐藏大小为512.
线性路由器计算出每个路由专家一个对数,单位为fp32.
每个令牌通过路由器登录到其前四位专家的路由中,其输出通过一个软max对这4个对数进行加权.
共享专家处理每个符号,其产出在没有门的情况下添加.
(Gale等人,2023年) Routing is dropless (Gale et al., 2023年) :没有专家有容量限制,没有降令牌.
负载平衡损失(Fedus等人,2022年),系数10 - 3 10 - 3) 将路由器推向专家使用的均衡分配。
专家精细:其隐藏尺寸为模型宽度的一半,一个符号激活了路由参数的1/321/32.
我们选择了专家人数和通过涂鸦造成的这种垃圾(C.1节)。 第6.2节分析了受训模式如何在各种语言之间分享专家。

blocks.en: 4 Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训

blocks.en:
All four stages of pretraining use a hybrid optimizer: Muon for the weight matrices of the layers and AdamW for the other parameters ( Section 4.1 ).
In the first three stages ( Section 2.3 ), the learning rate remains constant until the anneal, then decays to zero ( Table 5 ).
The fourth stage extends the context to 128k tokens with its own learning-rate schedule ( Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
所有四个阶段的预训都使用混合优化器: Muon指地层重量矩阵,AdamW指其他参数(第4.1节)。
在前三个阶段(第2.3节),学习率保持不变,直到肛门,然后衰减到零(表5).
第四阶段将上下文扩展至128k符号,并有自己的学习率时间表(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pretraining Recipe
blocks.zh: 4.1 预训课程

blocks.en:
Muon ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) updates the layer weight matrices, experts included, and AdamW the other parameters; all of them share one learning rate and one weight decay ( Table 5 , details in Appendix B ).
In our ablations, AdamW needed 1.5 to 1.9 times as many tokens as Muon to reach the same training loss ( Section C.1 ).
blocks.zh:
Muon(Jordan等人,2024年)更新了层重矩阵,专家包括,AdamW更新了其他参数;所有参数都共享一个学习率和一个重量衰减(表5,附录B的细节)。
在我们的战役中,AdamW需要比Muon多1.5到1.9倍的标志才能达到同样的训练损失(C.1节)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Architecture of Lara Mini base . Parameter counts include the embedding, counted once.
blocks.zh: 表4: Lara Mini基地的建筑 参数计数包括嵌入,一次计数.

blocks.en:
Large logits are a common source of instability in bf16 training. Lara Mini base bounds logits after each softmax.
Besides the query and key normalization ( Henry et al., 2020 ) and the fp32 router of Section 3 , it adds an output z-loss with coefficient 10 − 4 10^{-4} ( Chowdhery et al., 2023 ) and a router z-loss of 10 − 3 10^{-3} ( Zoph et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
大对数是bf16训练中不稳定的一个常见来源. 拉腊 迷你基数在每一个软马克之后会限制日志 。
除了查询和关键正常化(Henry et al.,2020年)和第3节的fp32路由器,它增加了一个输出z-损失,系数为10−4 10^{-4}(Chowdhery et al.,2023年)和一个路由器z-损失为10−3 10^{-3}(Zoph et al.,2022年).

blocks.en: Table 5: Hyperparameters of the first three stages of pretraining (6T tokens).
blocks.zh: 表5:前三个培训阶段的超参数(6T令牌)。

blocks.en:
The long-context stage uses 100B tokens ( Section 2.3 ), with the settings of Table 12 ( Appendix B ) taking over the last anneal optimizer state.
These 100B tokens are 1.7% of the tokens of the first three stages, in line with the 0.8% to 1.8% of Olmo 3, Kolibri, SmolLM3 and Apertus ( Team Olmo, 2025 ; Aleph Alpha, 2026 ; Hugging Face, 2025c ; Hernández-Cano et al., 2026 ) .
The learning rate warms up to 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} , a tenth of the peak of the first three stages, and decays to zero over the last 15B tokens.
The position encoding is unchanged: the global attention layers use none ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , and the sliding-window layers never attend beyond 512 tokens ( Section 3.1 ).
Unlike in the first three stages, documents packed into one sequence do not interact: attention is masked across documents and the Gated DeltaNet state restarts at each document.
Llama 3 found this masking important in continued pretraining on very long sequences ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . Section 5.7 evaluates the result.
blocks.zh:
长文阶段采用100B令牌(第2.3节),其中表12的设置(附录B)占据了最后一个肛门优化状态.
这些100B的代币是前三个阶段的代币的1.7%,与奥尔莫3,科利布里,斯摩尔LM3和阿珀图斯的0.8%至1.8%一致(Team Olmo,2025;Aleph Alpha,2026;Hugging Face,2025c;Hernández-Cano等人,2026年).
学习率高达8×10−5 8\times 10×5},是前三个阶段最高峰的十分之一,在最后15B个符号上衰变为零.
位置编码不变:全球关注层没有使用(Yang等人,2025年b),滑动窗层在512个令牌之后从未出现(第3.1节).
与前三个阶段不同的是,被打包成一个序列的文档不会相互作用:注意力被遮蔽在文档之间,Gated DeltaNet状态在每个文档中重新启动.
Llama 3发现这种面具在持续对非常长的序列进行预训中很重要(Grattafiori等人,2024年). 第5.7节评价了结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训动态

blocks.en:
Training was stable throughout: the loss never exceeded its median over the preceding 1,000 steps by more than 3%, and expert utilization remained nearly uniform ( Appendix B ).
Because the training loss shifts with the data mixture at each stage boundary, we followed progress on a fixed held-out set and on the evaluation suite of Section 5 ( Figure 4 ).
During the main stage, the Overall average (the mean of the four domain averages) rose gradually from 41.1 at 1.5T tokens to 44.1 at 4.6 T tokens.
The transition stage, which increases the share of code and math, mainly improved these two domains.
The anneal, which decays the learning rate on the highest-quality mixture, improved every domain.
From the last checkpoint before the anneal (5.2T tokens) to its end, the Overall average rose by 10.5 points and math by 22.6.
English and multilingual scores improved together at every evaluated checkpoint, both in the main stage and in the anneal.
blocks.zh:
整个培训情况稳定:损失从未超过前1 000个步骤的中位数超过3%,专家利用率几乎一致(附录B)。
由于培训损失随着各个阶段边界上的数据混合而变化,我们跟踪了第5节(图4)固定搁置套件和评价套件的进展情况。
在主要阶段,总体平均值(四个域平均值的平均值)逐渐从41.1,1.5T令牌上升到44.1,4.6T令牌.
过渡阶段增加了代码和数学的比例,主要改进了这两个领域.
肛门使最高质量混合物上的学习率衰减,改善了每一个领域。
从肛门前的最后一个检查站(5.2T令牌)到终点,总平均上升10.5分,数学上升22.6.
每个经评估的检查站,无论是在主要阶段还是在肛门,英文和多语种的分数都有所改善。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Scores of Lara Mini base on the evaluation suite of Section 5 at eight checkpoints of the first three stages: Overall and domain averages, with the learning-rate schedule and the training stages on top. Shading marks the transition (4.8–5.4T) and anneal (5.4–6T) stages; lines only join the evaluated checkpoints. Every domain improves fastest during the anneal.
blocks.zh: 图4:在前三个阶段的八个检查站,第5节评价套装上Lara Mini基地的分数: 总体和领域平均值,其中学习率表和培训阶段处于顶端。 沙丁标志着过渡阶段(4.8-5.4T)和肛门阶段(5.4-6T);线路只加入经评估的检查站。 每个域在肛门期间的改进最快.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en:
We compare Lara Mini base against 56 open base models across 26 benchmarks in four domains: English knowledge and reasoning, multilingual understanding, math and code.
The comparison tests whether a model trained on only 41% English data remains competitive in English and leads in the other languages.
We evaluate the released Lara Mini base , the checkpoint after the long-context stage ( Section 4.1 ); Section 5.7 reports its long-context results.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了Lara Mini基础与以下四个领域26个基准的56个开放基础模型: 英语知识与推理,多语种理解,数学与代码.
比较测试一个只接受过41%英语数据培训的模型是否仍然具有英语竞争力,并领先于其他语言。
我们评价Lara Mini基地,即长文阶段后的检查站(第4.1节);第5.7节报告了长文阶段的结果。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
Lara Mini base is a base model, so we evaluate it as one, with few-shot or zero-shot prompts ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Gu et al., 2025 ) and no chat template.
We compare it only with other pretrained base models, never with instruction-tuned ones.
We score every model ourselves, with the same prompts, settings and answer extraction, using lm-evaluation-harness ( Biderman et al., 2024 ) .
Log-likelihood tasks run on the Hugging Face backend with log-softmax in fp32, and generative tasks on vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
The two backends agree within 0.6 points on the tasks we checked.
blocks.zh:
Lara Mini碱基是一个基础模型,因此我们评价它为一体,少拍或零拍的提示(Brown等人,2020年;Gu等人,2025年),没有聊天模板.
我们只与其他训练有素的基地模型进行比较, 从未与训练有素的模型进行比较。
我们用同样的提示、设置和回答提取,
log-likelihood任务运行在hugging Face后端,fp32中的log-softmax,以及vLLM上的基因任务(Kwon等人,2023年).
两个后台在0.6分内就我们检查的任务达成一致.

blocks.en:
Table 17 in Appendix D lists the benchmarks and their settings.
We call the languages of the training data of Lara Mini base its supported languages.
As is common for models trained on a defined set of languages ( Martins et al., 2025b ; Ali et al., 2025 ; Gonzalez-Agirre et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate on the supported ones. Section D.2 reports the results per language.
One multilingual benchmark, T-HellaSwag, is our own translation of HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) ( Section 5.2 ).
Each domain average is the mean of its benchmarks, and the Overall average gives the four domains equal weight.
Code is scored by executing the generated programs.
HumanEval is not in the suite, because all of its items occur in the public datasets of our training pool ( Section 2.2 ).
blocks.zh:
附录中的表17 D列出了基准及其设置.
我们称Lara Mini的培训数据的语言是其辅助语言的基础。
常见的是对一组特定语言的培训模式(Martins等人,2025年b); Ali等人,2025年;Gonzalez-Agirre等人,2025年),我们对支助对象进行评估。 D.2节报告每种语文的结果。
一个多语种基准T-HellaSwag是我们自己翻译的HellaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年)(第5.2节).
每个域平均值是其基准的平均值,总体平均值给予四个域同等的权重.
代码通过执行生成的程序来打分.
HumanEval不在套房内,因为它的所有项目都发生在我们训练库的公共数据集中(第2.2节)。

blocks.en:
Following Muennighoff et al. (2025b) , we group the 56 baselines by active parameters, which approximate the cost of inference.
The three groups have up to 2B, from 2B to 4B and more than 4B active parameters.
The boundary between the last two groups is at 5B, so that the 4B models, with up to 4.7B active parameters, fall in the second.
Gemma-4-E2B and Gemma-4-E4B, whose 5.1B and 7.9B parameters include per-layer embeddings, are placed at their 2B and 4B effective sizes.
We checked that this grouping compares models of similar inference cost by measuring the generation speed of 45 of them on one GPU ( Appendix E ).
For a single user, every measured model in the two larger groups generates text 1.4 to 4.2 times more slowly than Lara Mini base .
In its own group, 21 of the 28 other measured models are slower as well. Table 6 shows 27 of the 56 baselines, and Section D.1 reports all 56 models on every benchmark, including those named in the text but not in the table.
blocks.zh:
继Muennighoff等人(2025年b)之后,我们用活性参数将56个基线进行分类,这大致相当于推论的成本。
这三个组最多有2B,从2B到4B以及超过4B的活性参数.
后两组的边界为5B,因此4B模型,最多可达4.7B活性参数,在第二组中落下.
Gemma-4-E2B和Gemma-4-E4B,其5.1B和7.9B参数包括每层嵌入,它们被放置在它们的2B和4B有效尺寸上.
我们检查过,这种组合通过在一个GPU(附录E)上测量其中45个模型的生成速度,比较了类似推论成本的模型。
对于一个单一的用户来说,两个较大组中每个被测量的模型生成的文本比Lara Mini基数慢1.4到4.2倍.
在其自身的组中,其他28个测量模型中的21个也比较慢. 表6显示56个基线中的27个,D.1节报告每个基准的所有56个模型,包括正文中列出的模型,但不在表中列出。

blocks.en: 5.2 T-HellaSwag
blocks.zh: 5.2 T-Hella号 交换

blocks.en:
T-HellaSwag is our higher-quality machine translation of the English commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) into 110 language variants of 105 languages; we include it in our evaluation suite and will release it.
The variants are written in 25 scripts, and 46 of them use a script other than Latin.
Each variant holds 200 documents, 22,000 in all, selected for translation quality while keeping the difficulty of the English originals.
T-HellaSwag-full holds all 10,042 translated documents of each variant.
A multilingual version of HellaSwag already exists, Multilingual HellaSwag ( Lai et al., 2023 ) , which covers 33 languages.
We compared the two translations across 50 documents per language using two LLM judges: Gemini 4 Argon ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and Claude Opus 5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) .
In the 32 languages they share, both judges preferred our translation in more than 98% of the documents. Appendix F describes how we translated and selected the documents, how we assessed the translation quality, and the limitations of the dataset.
blocks.zh:
T -Hella (英语). Swag是我们将英语常识推理基准HelaSwag(Zellers等人,2019年)翻译成105种语言的110种语言变体的更高质量的机器翻译;我们把它纳入我们的评价套件,并将发布.
变体用25个脚本书写,其中46个使用拉丁文以外的文字.
每个变体持有200份文件,总共22,000份,为翻译质量选定,同时保留英文原件的难度。
T -Hella (英语). Swag-full持有每个变体的所有10,042份翻译文件.
HelaSwag的多语种版本已经存在,多语种HelaSwag(Lai等人,2023年),涵盖33种语言.
我们用两位LLM评委(双子座4 Argon(Google DeepMind,2026年)和克劳德·奥普斯·5.5(Anthropic,2026年)),
在他们共同使用的32种语言中,两位法官都倾向于我们98%以上的文件的翻译。 附 录 F描述了我们如何翻译和选择文件,如何评估翻译质量,以及数据集的局限性。

blocks.en: 5.3 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 主要成果

blocks.en:
Among the 36 models with up to 2B active parameters ( Table 6 ), Lara Mini base ranks first overall (57.0, 3.1 points above granite-4.0-h-tiny) and on the multilingual average (56.7, 3.4 points above Gemma-4-E2B).
It is also first on math, second on English and fifth on code.
Six of the 56 models score higher overall and six on the multilingual average, all in the two larger groups, with 4 to 14 times as many active parameters as Lara Mini base ( Table 18 ).
Of these models, the four that report their pretraining tokens were trained on 18T to 36T, 3 to 6 times as many as Lara Mini base . Lara Mini base also scores higher overall than several models with 6 to 13 times its active parameters, such as Ministral-3-3B, Gemma-4-E4B, Apertus-v1.5-8B and Llama-3.1-8B. Figure 1 summarizes the same results.
blocks.zh:
在最多有2B活性参数的36种模型中(表6),Lara Mini碱基总体排名第一(5.0,花岗岩-4.0-h-tiny以上3.1分),在多语种平均排名上(Gemma-4-E2B以上56.7,3.4分).
它也是数学第一,英语第二,代码第五。
在56种模型中,有6种总体得分较高,6种在多语种平均得分上,均在两个较大的组中,活性参数是Lara Mini基数(表18)的4至14倍.
在这些模型中,报告其预训符的4个在18T至36T上接受了训练,是Lara Mini基地的3至6倍。 拉腊 迷你基座的总得分也高于几个模型,其有效参数为6至13倍,如Ministry-3-3B,Gemma-4-E4B,Apertus-v1.5-8B和Llama-3.1-8B. 图1总结了同样的结果。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 plots the Overall average of each model against the speed at which it generates text for a single user.
Speed is measured in characters per second, so that models with tokenizers of different densities can be compared on equal footing. Lara Mini base lies on the Pareto frontier: the seven faster models score at most 42.6, and every model that scores higher generates text at least 1.8 times more slowly.
The closest of them in Overall average, MiniCPM5-2B, is 0.5 points higher but 8.7 points lower on the multilingual average.
The speed advantage of Lara Mini base is largest for a single user and on long prompts, and narrows when many users share the GPU ( Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
图5按每个模型生成单一用户文本的速度绘制了每个模型的总体平均值。
速度用字符每秒测量,这样,具有不同密度的标致器的模型就可以在平等的基础上进行比较. 拉腊 迷你基座位于帕雷托边疆:七个更快的模型得分最多42.6分,每个得分较高的模型产生文字的速度至少是1.8倍.
其中最接近的总平均值为MiniCPM5-2B,比多语种平均值高0.5个百分点,但低8.7个百分点。
Lara Mini基的速度优势对于单个用户和在长提示上是最大的,当许多用户共享GPU(附录E)时则缩小.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Lara Mini base after the long-context stage ( Section 4.1 ) at 32k and 128k tokens on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) (13 synthetic English tasks), ONERULER ( Kim et al., 2025 ) (retrieval tasks in 26 languages) and HELMET ( Yen et al., 2025 ) (mostly application-centric English tasks).
Since Lara Mini base is a base model, it continues generating text after its answer.
We therefore keep only the tasks whose scores do not depend on that text: four retrieval tasks for ONERULER and four categories for HELMET ( Section D.3 ).

我们评价Lara Mini在长文本阶段(第4.1节)之后的32k和128k令牌(RULAR(Hsieh等人,2024年))(13项合成英语任务)、ONERULER(Kim等人,2025年)(26种语言检索任务)和HELMET(Yen等人,2025年)(大多以应用为中心英语任务)。
自拉腊以来 迷你基础是一个基础模型,它继续生成答案后的文本.
因此,我们只保留其分数不取决于该案文的任务:为ONERULER执行四项检索任务,为HELMET执行四项类别(D.3节)。

On RULER and HELMET, it trails only Qwen3.5-2B and Gemma-4-E2B, which have about three times its active parameters.
The long-context stage barely changes short-context scores: on the benchmarks in Table 6 , the Overall average changes by less than 0.1 points, and no domain average by more than 0.8 points.

blocks.en: 6 Multilingual Data and Model Capacity
blocks.zh: 6 多语种数据和模型能力

blocks.en:
The introduction raised a common concern about multilingual pretraining: at small scales, languages compete for the model’s capacity ( Conneau et al., 2020 ; Chang et al., 2024 ) .
If they did in Lara Mini base , two signs should be visible.
First, its multilingual data would cost English: replacing them with English would clearly raise English scores.
Second, its mixture of experts would serve the languages by dividing its experts among them, so that each language uses only part of the model.
blocks.zh:
引言引起了对多语种预训的共同关注:在小规模上,语言竞争模型的能力(Conneau等人,2020年;Chang等人,2024年)。
如果在Laramini基地发现,
首先,其多语种数据将耗资英语:用英语取代它们显然会提高英语分数.
第二,由专家组成的混合体通过在其中分配专家来服务于这些语言,因此每种语言只使用模式的一部分。

blocks.en:
We scored the anneals of Section 6.1 and the short runs of Sections C.1 and C.2 on a development suite.
Its 17 benchmarks are the English and multilingual benchmarks in Table 17 , excluding ARC-Challenge and MMLU-Pro.
MMLU-Pro remained at chance level (10%) in the short runs trained from scratch, and we exclude it from all development scores so that they all average to the same benchmarks.
The development suite uses its own prompts and, unless otherwise stated, averages across all languages within each benchmark, so its scores are not comparable to those in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
我们得到了6.1节的肛门 和C.1和C.2节的短跑 在开发套房。
它的17个基准是表17中的英文和多语种基准,不包括ARC-Challenge和MMLU-Pro。
MMLU-Pro在从零开始的短期训练中一直处于机会水平(10%),我们将其排除在所有发展分数之外,以便它们都平均达到相同的基准。
开发套件使用自己的提示,除非另有说明,每个基准内所有语文的平均值,因此其分数与第5节中的分数不相上下。

blocks.en: 6.1 Multilingual Share
blocks.zh: 6.1 多语种份额

blocks.en:
To test the first sign, we branched two anneals of 100B tokens from the training run of Lara Mini base at the end of its transition stage (5.4T tokens).
Both decayed the learning rate to zero and differed only in their mixture.
The first used the anneal mixture of Lara Mini base , with 27% English, 33% multilingual and 40% code, math and SFT-like data.
The second replaced all multilingual data with English, at 60% English and the same 40% of code, math and SFT-like data.
We scored both on the development suite, averaging the multilingual benchmarks over the supported languages as in Section 5 ( Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh:
为了测试第一个标志,我们从Lara Mini基地在过渡阶段末期(5.4T标志)的训练中分出两个100B标志的Anneals.
两者将学习率衰减到零,仅在混合物上有所不同.
最早使用Lara Mini碱基的肛门混合物,其中英语占27%,多语种占33%,代码占40%,数学和SFT类数据.
第二部以英语取代了所有多语种数据,英语为60%,同样40%的代码,数学和类似SFT的数据.
我们在开发套件上都得分,同第5节(图6)一样,平均衡量所支助语文的多种语文基准。

blocks.en:
With more than twice as much English data in the anneal, the English average rose by only 0.3 points, about a tenth of the 2.7 points that the multilingual average lost on the supported languages ( Figure 6 ).
Without multilingual data, the score was lower on eight of the nine multilingual benchmarks, by up to 4.6 points on commonsense and knowledge benchmarks such as Global PIQA, XCOPA, T-HellaSwag and INCLUDE.
The multilingual data cost math and code less than half a point.
On the math and code benchmarks of Section 5 , the anneal with multilingual data scored 53.8 and 43.6, and the one without it 54.2 and 43.7.
A likely reason for the small English gain is that, by the end of the transition stage, the model had already read more than 2T English tokens, so that additional English in the anneal added little.
The test covers only the anneal: it does not measure the effect of the multilingual share during the main stage.
blocks.zh:
肛门的英语数据是英语数据的两倍多,英语平均只上升0.3点,约占被支持语言中多语种平均损失的2.7点的十分之一(图6).
如果没有多语种数据,9个多语种基准中的8个基准的得分较低,全球PIQA、XCOPA、T-HellaSwag和INCLUDE等常识和知识基准的得分最高达4.6分。
多语言数据花费的数学和代码不足半点.
关于第5节的数学和代码基准,有多种语言数据的肛门得分为53.8和43.6,没有数据的肛门得分为54.2和43.7。
小英增益的一个可能原因是,到过渡阶段结束时,该型号已经读取了超过2T的英语令牌,因此肛门中的额外英语几乎没有增加.
测试只涵盖肛门:它不测量主舞台上多语种分享的效果.

blocks.en: Takeaway. In the anneal, replacing the multilingual third of the mixture with English raises the English average by 0.3 points and lowers the multilingual average by 2.7 points.
blocks.zh: 外卖 在肛门中,用英语取代混合语的多语种三分之一,使英语的平均值提高了0.3分,使多语种的平均值降低了2.7分.

blocks.en: 6.2 Expert Routing across Languages
blocks.zh: 6.2 跨语种的专家路线

blocks.en:
To test the second sign, we ran the released Lara Mini base on the Belebele passages ( Bandarkar et al., 2024 ) , the same text in each supported language, and recorded the experts to which each token was routed.
In each layer, we measured the Jensen–Shannon divergence between each language’s distribution over the routed experts and the mean distribution across all 43 languages ( Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh:
为了测试第二个标志,我们在Belebele通道上运行了已发行的Lara Mini基地(Bandarkar et al., 2024年),每种支持语言的文本相同,并记录了每个标志的路由的专家.
在每一层,我们测量了每种语言在路由专家的分布与所有43种语言的平均分布之间的差距(图7)。

blocks.en:
Routing differs between languages in the first and last layers and is almost identical in the middle of the network, with an average divergence of at most 0.015 bits in layers 10 to 17.
In layers 2 to 7, 31 of the 37 languages with a relative among the 43 route most like that relative, for example, Catalan like Spanish, Czech like Slovak, and Estonian like Finnish.
The grouping follows the language rather than the script: Serbian, written in Cyrillic, routes most like Croatian, and Maltese, written in Latin script, most like Arabic.
Languages, therefore, share experts rather than divide them, which is consistent with the small cost of multilingual data for English ( Section 6.1 ).
Together, the two analyses find little of the competition that the concern predicts, but they do not show whether the mixture of experts or the data selection is responsible.
blocks.zh:
首层和末层各语言的轮廓不同,在网络中间几乎完全相同,在10至17层的平均差值最多为0.015比特.
在第2至7层中,37种语言中,有31种语言的相对性在43种路线中最为相似,例如,加泰罗尼亚语如西班牙语,捷克语如斯洛伐克语,爱沙尼亚语如芬兰语。
编组采用语言而不是文字:塞尔维亚语,用西里尔语写成,路线最像克罗地亚语,马耳他语,用拉丁字母写成,大多数像阿拉伯语.
因此,语文共用专家,而不是分成专家,这与英语多语种数据的小额费用是一致的(第6.1节)。
这两项分析加在一起,发现关注所预测的竞争不多,但它们并没有显示专家的混合体或数据选择是负责的.

blocks.en:
These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that multilingual learning benefits from shared representations rather than requiring separate capacity for each language.
This resembles the positive transfer observed in multi-task learning ( Caruana, 1997 ) and multilingual neural machine translation ( Firat et al., 2016 ) .
One possible explanation is that different languages provide complementary constraints on representations of underlying concepts, allowing the model to generalize across linguistic boundaries.
However, shared expert routing does not directly establish shared semantic representations, and our experiments do not demonstrate that multilingual training improves general reasoning or English performance.
blocks.zh:
这些结论符合以下假设:多语种学习从共同表述中受益,而不是要求每种语言具有单独的能力。
这类似于在多任务学习(Caruana,1997年)和多语种神经机译(Firat等人,2016年)中观察到的正转移。
一种可能的解释是,不同语言对基本概念的表达提供了互补的限制,使模型能够跨越语言界限加以概括。
然而,共享专家的路由并不直接建立共享语义表达,我们的实验也没有表明多语种培训改善了一般推理或英语的性能.

blocks.en: Takeaway. Lara Mini base does not divide its experts among languages: related languages share experts in the first layers, and the middle layers route all languages alike.
blocks.zh: 外卖 拉腊 迷你基础不将其专家在语言之间划分:相关语言共享第一层的专家,中间层同样途径所有语言.

Languages route differently in the first and last layers and almost identically in the middle layers.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Lara Mini base , a mixture of experts base model with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters.
It was pretrained on 6T tokens, only 41% of which were in English, and in the anneal, text from the 44 other languages is the largest domain in the mixture.
Its context was then extended to 128k tokens.
Among the 36 open base models with up to 2B active parameters, Lara Mini base ranks first on the Overall average, on math and on the multilingual average in the languages it supports, and second on English.
It achieves this at a small inference cost: for a single user, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than every model with a higher Overall average.
It is also the first among the models we compared on the multilingual long-context benchmark, ONERULER, at 32k tokens ( Section 5.7 ).
The concern that languages compete for the capacity of a small model found little support in Lara Mini base .
Replacing its multilingual data with English in the anneal raised the English average by only 0.3 points and lowered the multilingual average by 2.7 ( Section 6.1 ).
Its languages also share the same experts rather than dividing them ( Section 6.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了Lara Mini碱基,一种由7.2B总参数和0.6B活性参数组成的专家碱基模型。
它在6T令牌上预训,只有41%是英语,在肛门中,来自其他44种语言的文本是混合物中最大的域.
其上下文随后扩展至128k令牌.
在拥有最多2B活性参数的36个开放基数中,Lara Mini基数在总体平均数中位居第一,在其支持的语言中位居数学和多语种平均数中位居第二,在英语中位居第二。
它以微小的推论成本实现这一点:对单个用户来说,它生成文本的速度至少是每个模型的1.8倍,总体平均值较高.
它也是我们在多语种长文基准(ONERULER)上以32k符号(第5.7节)比较的第一个模型。
在Lara Mini基地,
用英语取代其英语数据在肛门中只提高了英语平均值0.3个百分点,将多语种平均值降低了2.7个百分点(第6.1节)。
其语言也具有相同的专家,而不是分化专家(第6.2节)。

blocks.en:
Beyond the absence of a substantial capacity penalty, our results motivate a broader hypothesis: linguistic diversity may contribute to general-purpose intelligence by exposing a model to complementary descriptions of the world.
This interpretation connects multilingual pretraining to established ideas in multi-task learning and representation learning.
Testing whether language diversity directly improves general reasoning remains an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh:
除了缺乏实质性的能力惩罚外,我们的成果还激发了一个更广泛的假设:语言多样性可能通过将一个模型暴露于对世界的补充性描述而促进通用智能。
这种解释将多语种预训与多任务学习和代表性学习中的既定思想联系起来.
测试语言多样性是否直接改善一般推理,仍然是未来研究的一个重要方向.

blocks.en:
We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, and will release T-HellaSwag ( Appendix F ).
The data pipeline and the training pool remain internal, but Sections 2 and A describe the mixture in full.
blocks.zh:
依据CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可,
数据管道和培训库仍然是内部的,但第2节和A节全面描述了混合物。

blocks.en:
Lara Mini base is a base model: it is not tuned to follow instructions or for safety, and should not be deployed as an assistant without further training.
Its quality varies across languages.
Among the languages it supports, it scores lowest in some with limited training data, such as Azerbaijani and Bengali ( Section D.2 ).
Our analyses show that the multilingual data cost English little in the anneal.
They do not measure the effect of these data during the main stage, nor show which of our choices keeps the cost small.
blocks.zh:
Lara Mini基地是一个基地模式:它不听命于指示或安全,不应作为助理部署而不经过进一步培训。
其质量因语言而异.
在它所支持的语言中,在有些培训数据有限的语言中,它得分最低,如阿塞拜疆语和孟加拉语(D.2节)。
我们的分析表明,多语种数据在肛门里成本很少。
它们没有衡量这些数据在主要阶段的效果,也没有显示我们选择哪一个能够保持较低的成本。

blocks.en:
We plan to post-train Lara Mini base into an instruction-following model, extend the training to larger budgets and more languages, and further study how the multilingual share of the mixture affects each language and English.
We also plan controlled experiments that vary linguistic diversity during the main pretraining stage, while keeping compute, total tokens, and data quality comparable, and measure the effects on English, math, code, and multilingual performance.
blocks.zh:
我们计划将Lara Mini基地培训后纳入一个遵循教学模式,将培训扩大到更大的预算和更多的语言,并进一步研究混合语言中的多语种比例如何影响每种语言和英语。
我们还计划进行控制实验,这些实验在主预训阶段会改变语言多样性,同时保持计算、总符号和数据质量的可比性,并衡量对英语、数学、代码和多语言性能的影响。

blocks.en: B.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: B.1 培训详情

blocks.en:
Muon ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) replaces the update of a weight matrix with an orthogonalized version of its momentum, computed with five Newton–Schulz iterations.
We use Nesterov momentum with coefficient 0.95.
Muon updates every two-dimensional weight inside the layers: the attention projections, the input and output projections of the Gated DeltaNet layers, and the routed and shared experts.
Queries, keys and values are orthogonalized separately, and so is each expert.
AdamW handles the tied embedding, the normalization weights, the routers, and the one-dimensional and convolutional parameters of the Gated DeltaNet layers.
Following Liu et al. (2025) , we scale each orthogonalized update by 0.2 ​ max ⁡ ( n in , n out ) 0.2\sqrt{\max(n_{\mathrm{in}},n_{\mathrm{out}})} , which matches its root-mean-square size to that of an AdamW update.
All parameters therefore share a single learning rate and a decoupled weight decay of 0.1.
blocks.zh:
Muon (Jordan等人, 2024年) 将重量矩阵的更新换成正交式的动力,用5个牛顿-舒尔兹迭代计算。
我们使用Nesterov动力 系数0.95。
Muon更新了层内每个二维的重量:注意力预测,Gated DeltaNet层的输入和输出预测,以及路由和共享的专家.
查询,密钥和值是分别的正统化,每个专家也是这样.
AdamW处理捆绑嵌入物,常态权重,路由器,以及Gated DeltaNet层的一维和演化参数.
继刘等人(2025年)之后,我们将每个正交化的更新缩放0.2 max(n in,n out ) 0.2\sqrt\max(n_{\mathrm{in}},n_{\mathrm{out}})),使其根-正方形大小与亚当W的更新相匹配.
因此,所有参数都具有单一的学习率和0.1的脱钩重量衰减。

blocks.en:
The ablations in Appendix C used a learning rate of 1.2 × 10 − 3 1.2\times 10^{-3} , but the 6T run has twice their batch size and 60 times their number of tokens, so we tuned it again.
Since a sweep over 6T tokens was out of reach, we measured how the optimal learning rate varies with training length and extrapolated the trend to 6T.
The sweep ran on a quarter-width proxy with μ \mu P ( Yang et al., 2021 ) , so that its best learning rate carries over to the full width, at the batch size of the final run and up to 74B tokens.
At constant learning rate, the best value at a given length is hard to read, because the loss does not include the gain of the final decay.
Reading it from averages of recent checkpoints, the best learning rate decreased with training length and extrapolated to about 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} ; this estimate is biased low, since the average recovers less of the decay gain of high learning rates as training gets longer.
Reading it after real decays at 22, 50 and 74B tokens, the best learning rate did not fall, which gives about 2.4 × 10 − 3 2.4\times 10^{-3} ; this estimate is biased high, since the optimum may still fall beyond 74B.
We chose 8 × 10 − 4 8\times 10^{-4} , close to the geometric mean of the two estimates.

附录C中的缩写使用1.2×10−3 1.2\times 10×3}的学习率,但6T跑有其批量大小的两倍和其符号数的60倍,所以我们再调一次.
由于对6T符号的扫射是无法达到的,我们衡量了最佳学习率如何随培训时间长短而变化,并推断出趋势为6T。

在恒定学习速率下,特定长度的最佳值很难读取,因为损失不包括最终衰变的得益.
从最近检查站的平均数来看,最佳学习率随着培训时间的缩短而下降,并推断为大约3×10−4 3\times 10×4 4};这一估计是偏低的,因为随着培训时间的延长,平均恢复率低于高学习率的衰败收益。
在22,50和74B的符号真正衰减后读它,最好的学习率并没有下降,这给出了大约2.4××10−3 2.4\times 10^{-3};这一估计是偏高的,因为最佳的可能仍然在74B之外.
我们选择了8×10×4 8\times 10×4],接近两个估计的几何平均值.

blocks.en: C.1 Model Class, Shape and Optimizer
blocks.zh: C.1 型号类别、形状和优化器

blocks.en:
We compared candidate architectures at about 0.5B active parameters ( Table 13 ) under a protocol fixed before the first run.
Each candidate was trained once on 100B tokens using the same data in the same order, with 4,096-token sequences and 1,024-sequence batches.
The learning rate peaked at 1.2 × 10 − 3 1.2\times 10^{-3} , stayed constant up to 80B tokens and decayed to zero over the last 20B ( Hägele et al., 2024 ) .
We report the mean scores on the development suite and the final model’s loss on a fixed held-out set of 128M tokens, evaluated using the same batches for every model.
This loss is not comparable with the held-out loss of Appendix B .
Losses at intermediate token counts are those of the average of eight constant-learning-rate checkpoints, which approximates a model annealed at that point ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
These runs used global attention in every layer, and AdamW except in the last comparison.
The hybrid layers ( Section C.2 ) were adopted afterward.
blocks.zh:
我们根据第一次运行前确定的一项协议,以0.5B活性参数(表13)对候选架构进行了比较。
每个考生在100B令牌上接受过一次培训,使用相同的数据顺序相同,有4,096个托肯序列和1,024个序列批次.
学习率达到顶峰,为1.2×10 − 3 1.2\times 10^{-3},恒定80B令牌,并在最后20B年衰败为零(Hägele等人,2024年).
我们报告开发套件的平均分数, 以及最后型号的损失,
这一损失与附录B的搁置损失不相称。
中间值损失是8个经常学习率检查站的平均损失,这大约相当于当时一个模型被遗忘(Li等人,2025年)。
这些运行在每一层都使用了全球关注度,亚当W除了最后的比较.
杂交层(C.2节)后来通过.

Experts are given as number × \times hidden size, with the number active per token. All rows use AdamW except the last. Highlighted is the configuration of Lara Mini base , before the hybrid attention. Every MoE ends with a lower loss than both dense models.

blocks.en:
The MoE was ahead of both dense models from the start.
With 64 experts, the MoE ended with a lower loss than the 1.24B dense model, which has 2.4 times as many active parameters.
The gap between the MoE and the 0.6B dense model was already 0.219 nats at 5B tokens and did not shrink.
Doubling the experts at the same active compute reduced the loss further as training progressed, from 0.011 at 5B tokens to 0.041 at 100 B tokens.
The deeper, narrower shape with 34 layers started behind (0.036 higher loss at 5B tokens) and tied the 24-layer shape at 100B.
We chose it because it scored at or above the 24-layer shape on 13 of the 17 benchmarks and has 0.35B fewer total parameters.
A shared expert ( Dai et al., 2024 ) , which every token passes through, adds 0.05B active parameters.
The loss reduction it brought was stable from about 25B tokens on, and the model with it scored higher than the one without on 12 of the 17 benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
教育部从一开始就领先于这两种密集型号。
拥有64位专家,MOE最终损失比1.24B稠密型号要低,该型号的有效参数是2.4倍.
MOE与0.6B稠密型号的差距已经是5B令牌的0.219纳特,没有缩小.
在同一积极计算中,将专家加倍计算,进一步减少了损失,因为培训取得了进展,从5B级的0.011美元降至100B级的0.041美元。
更深,更窄的形状有34层,开始于后面(5B令牌的0.036更高损失),并将24层的形状绑在100B.
我们选择它,是因为它在17个基准中的13个基准的24层形状上或以上得分,总参数减少0.35B.
一个共享的专家(Dai et al.,2024),每个符号都会经过,增加了0.05B活性参数.
它带来的损失减少与大约25B个代币相比是稳定的,其模型的得分高于17个基准中12个基准中没有的。

blocks.en:
Muon ( Section 4.1 ) used the same peak learning rate as AdamW, selected by a sweep on a half-width proxy with μ \mu P ( Yang et al., 2021 ) and confirmed at full size.
With Muon, the held-out loss was lower at every intermediate point, by 0.19 at 5B tokens and by 0.04 to 0.05 from 40B tokens on.
AdamW needed 1.5 times as many tokens to reach Muon’s training loss between 10B and 30B tokens, and about 1.9 times as many at 80B.
Muon was also ahead on 15 of the 17 benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
Muon(第4.1节)使用与AdamW相同的峰值学习率,通过用μ \mu P(Yang等人,2021年)对半宽代用物进行扫瞄选择,并全尺寸确认.
与穆恩相比,每个中间点的搁置损失都较低,5B令牌比0.19低,40B令牌比0.05低。
亚当W需要1.5倍于10B到30B的训练损失,80B的训练损失约为1.9倍.
在17项基准中,穆恩也领先于15项基准。

blocks.en: Takeaway. At about 0.5B active parameters, a fine-grained MoE beats dense models with up to 2.4 times as many active parameters; a shared expert and Muon further lower the loss.
blocks.zh: 外卖 在约0.5B的活性参数上,精细的MOE用最多2.4倍的活性参数击败了密集的模型;一位共享的专家和穆恩进一步降低了损失.

blocks.en: C.2 Hybrid Attention
blocks.zh: C.2 双重注意

blocks.en:
We tested how much of the global attention can be replaced by Gated DeltaNet and sliding-window attention without losing quality.
Starting from the 34-layer shape with one shared expert, trained with Muon ( Section C.1 ), we compared three variants under the protocol of Section C.1 ( Table 14 ).
The first uses Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025c ) in 26 of the 34 layers, and the second uses sliding windows of 512 tokens in the same 26 layers.
The third is the hybrid of Lara Mini base , with 14 Gated DeltaNet and 13 sliding-window layers arranged exactly as in Section 3.1 .
The remaining layers keep global attention.
blocks.zh:
我们测试了全球关注的多少可以被Gated DeltaNet和滑窗关注所取代而不会失去质量.
从34层形状开始,我们与一名共享专家进行了穆恩培训(C.1节),我们根据C.1节的规程比较了三种变体(表14)。
第一种在34层中的26层使用Gated DeltaNet(杨等人,2025c),第二种在同样的26层使用512个令牌的滑动窗口.
第三个是Lara Mini基地的混合体,14个Gated DeltaNet和13个滑窗层的排列与第3.1节完全相同。
其余各层保持全球关注。

blocks.en: Table 14: Hybrid attention ablations at 100B tokens, against global attention in all 34 layers: change in held-out loss, mean change in score over the 17 benchmarks (points), and memory held per sequence during generation at 32k tokens, relative to global attention (computed as in Section 3.1 ). The oracle takes, on each benchmark, the better score of the two single-mixer variants. The single-mixer variants keep global attention across 8 layers, while the hybrid uses 7. The hybrid has the largest benchmark gain and the smallest memory.
blocks.zh: 表14:与全球关注相比,100B令牌的混合注意力与所有34层的全球关注相对应:搁置损失的变化,17个基准(点)的记分平均变化,以及相对于全球关注(如第3.1节所示),世代期间每个序列的内存为32k令牌。 甲骨文在每个基准上,取两个单元变体的较好分数. 单混音变体将全球注意力保持在8层,而混合音则使用7. 混合体具有最大的基准增益和最小的内存.

blocks.en:
Gated DeltaNet lowered the held-out loss by a margin that appeared early in training and held to the end ( Table 14 ).
This is consistent with the lower loss of Gated DeltaNet hybrids at matched budgets reported by Merrill et al. (2026) .
Sliding windows alone ended up on a level playing field with full attention.
blocks.zh:
三角洲 净值降低了在培训初期出现并一直维持到最后的差额(表14)。
这与Merrill等人(2026年)报告的相应预算中Gated DeltaNet混合体的损失较低是一致的。
单是滑动的窗子就最终被完全关注在了公平的游戏场地上.

blocks.en:
On benchmarks, the two single-mixer variants were strong on different tasks ( Table 15 ).
Gated DeltaNet was better on text completion and commonsense reasoning; sliding windows were better on tasks that compare two sentences, such as entailment.
The difference did not come from the length of the context, since most benchmark prompts fit within the window.
blocks.zh:
在基准方面,两个单一混合器的变体在不同任务上都很强(表15)。
Gated DeltaNet在文本完成和常识推理方面比较好;滑动窗口在比较两句(如引出)的任务方面比较好。
差异并不来自上下文的长度,因为大多数基准提示适合窗口。

blocks.en: Table 15: Benchmark families: accuracy of the sliding-window and hybrid variants minus that of the Gated DeltaNet variant, in points. Sliding windows help on entailment and paraphrase; Gated DeltaNet on the other families.
blocks.zh: 表15:基准家庭:滑窗和混合变种的准确性减去Gated DeltaNet变种的准确性,以点表示。 滑动的窗口有助于理解和解释;Gated DeltaNet关于其他家庭。

blocks.en:
The hybrid kept most of the loss gain of Gated DeltaNet with about half as many Gated DeltaNet layers.
On benchmarks, it kept the advantage of Gated DeltaNet on completion and commonsense reasoning and recovered most of the advantage of sliding windows on entailment ( Table 15 ).
It scored above full attention on 16 of the 17 benchmarks.
Its mean gain over full attention matched that of the oracle in Table 14 , which neither single-mixer variant reached.
blocks.zh:
混合体保留了Gated DeltaNet的大部分损失收益,拥有大约一半的Gated DeltaNet层.
在基准方面,它保持了Gated DeltaNet在完成和常识推理方面的优势,并恢复了滑动窗口在衍生物上的多数优势(表15)。
它在17个基准中的16个基准中得分高于充分关注。
它在充分关注之后得到的平均收益与表14中的甲骨文相匹配,两者都不是单一混合物的变体。

blocks.en:
To test whether the ranking holds beyond the training length, we extended the three variants from their 100B checkpoints with the same long-context stage.
This stage trained each variant on the same 10B tokens, in 32k-token sequences, with attention masked across documents.
We then evaluated them on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) , its multilingual counterpart ONERULER ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and HELMET ( Yen et al., 2025 ) at 16k and 32k tokens, and on the 17 short benchmarks ( Table 16 ).
The hybrid was the best on RULER and ONERULER at both lengths.
On HELMET, which also covers retrieval-augmented generation, re-ranking and in-context learning, the hybrid and Gated DeltaNet were level at 32k tokens and ahead of sliding windows.
The hybrid led on the two categories that require reading many passages, retrieval-augmented generation and re-ranking.
The extension did not hurt short-context quality: every variant gained slightly on the short benchmarks, and the hybrid remained the best.
blocks.zh:
为了测试排名是否超过训练时间,我们从他们的100B检查站延长了三个变种,具有相同的长篇舞台.
这个阶段在相同的10B令牌上对每个变体进行了32k-token序列的训练,注意力蒙蔽了文件.
然后,我们用讲多种语言的RULAR(Hsieh等人,2024年)对其进行了评价。 ONERULER(Kim等人,2025年)和HELMET(Yen等人,2025年)的指数为16k和32k,以及17个短期基准(表16)。
该混血儿在RULLR和ONERULER两个长度上都是最好的.
在HELMET上,它也涵盖检索的生成、重新排位和内文学习,混合式和Gated DeltaNet在32k符号和滑动窗口之前的水平。
混合体领先于需要阅读许多段落,检索-增强生成和重新排序的两类.
扩展不会伤害短篇质量:每个变体在短篇基准上略有增益,混合体仍然是最好的.

blocks.en: Table 16: Hybrid attention ablations after a long-context stage of 10B tokens at 32k: mean score over the 17 short benchmarks, and RULER (mean of 13 tasks), ONERULER (4 retrieval tasks in 26 languages) and HELMET (mean of its recall, RAG, re-ranking and in-context learning categories) at 16k and 32k tokens. The hybrid is best on RULER and ONERULER at both lengths.
blocks.zh: 表16:在长文阶段10B令牌为32k之后的混合注意:平均得分超过17个短文基准,RULAR(13项任务中的平均得分),ONERULER(26种语言的4项检索任务)和HELMET(其召回,RAG,重新排位和内文学习类别中的平均得分)为16k和32k令牌. 混合型在RULLR和ONERULER两个长度上都是最好的.

blocks.en: Takeaway. Interleaving Gated DeltaNet with sliding-window layers retains nearly all the loss gain of Gated DeltaNet and yields the best short- and long-context scores among the three variants, using global attention in only 7 of 34 layers.
blocks.zh: 外卖 Gated DeltaNet与滑动窗口层的连接保留了Gated DeltaNet几乎所有的损失收益,并在三个变体中产生最佳的短写和长写分数,仅利用了34层中的7层的全球关注.

blocks.en:
Figure 11 plots the score of Lara Mini base in each supported language against its training tokens in that language.
Each point is the score in the language minus the benchmark mean across the non-English-supported languages, averaged over multilingual benchmarks that cover the language.
Subtracting the benchmark mean removes the differences in chance level and difficulty between benchmarks.
The median score of the languages Lara Mini base does not support is 20 points below that of its supported languages.
Among the supported languages, the score grows only moderately with the number of training tokens (Spearman correlation 0.4).
Of the three classes of language in the figure, the official EU languages, which the language weights favor ( Section 2.3 ), have the highest median.
Serbian, with 8B training tokens, scores close to Russian, which has 21 times as many.
The weakest supported languages are Azerbaijani and Bengali, followed by Irish and Maltese, the two languages with the fewest training tokens.

减去基准意味着消除基准之间机会水平和难度的差异。
Laramini基础不支持的语言的中位分比其支持的语言低20分.
在被支持的语言中,分数仅随训练符数(Spearman conversation 0.4)而适度增长.
在图中的三类语言中,语言加权偏好的欧盟官方语言(第2.3节)中位数最高.
塞尔维亚语,拥有8B训练符,得分接近俄语,是俄语的21倍.
得到支持的最弱语言是阿塞拜疆语和孟加拉语,其次是爱尔兰语和马耳他语,这两种语言的培训标志最少。

blocks.en: D.4 Benchmark Contamination
blocks.zh: D.4 基准污染

blocks.en:
Here we test whether contamination inflates the scores of Lara Mini base .
HumanEval is excluded from the suite because nearly all of its items, including solutions, appear in public datasets in our pool ( Section 2.2 ).
Every other benchmark is used as released, with all its items.
On MMLU and MBPP, two tests verify that items from the training pool do not inflate  model’s score, against three references from its group: Llama-3.2-1B, granite-4.0-h-tiny, and Qwen3-1.7B.
We divide benchmark items into clean and potentially contaminated subsets based on whether our scan identifies overlap with the training pool.
This partition is applied consistently to all four models, although the training data of the reference models may differ from ours.
Neither test shows signs of memorization:  model’s scores are consistent with generalization.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们测试污染是否夸大了Lara Mini基地的几十个。
HumanEval被排除在套房之外,因为几乎所有项目,包括解决方案,都出现在我们集合的公共数据集中(第2.2节)。
所有其他基准及其所有项目均作为发布。
在MMLU和MBPP方面,有两次测试证实训练池中的物品不会提高模型的分数,而来自其小组的三处参考:Llama-3.2-1B、花岗岩4.0-h-tiny和Qune3-1.7B。
根据我们的扫描是否识别出与训练池的重叠,我们把基准项目分为清洁和潜在污染子集。
这种分区一致地适用于所有四个模型,尽管参照模型的培训数据可能与我们的不同。
两次测试都没有显示记忆的迹象:模型的分数与概括一致.

blocks.en:
A model that had memorized the contaminated items would score higher on them than on the clean ones, relative to the references ( Table 25 ). Lara Mini base does not: its difference is − 0.2 -0.2 points on MMLU (references: − 0.7 -0.7 to + 2.0 +2.0 ) and − 9.2 -9.2 on MBPP ( − 15.6 -15.6 to − 8.4 -8.4 ).
Both differences fall within the reference-model ranges, providing no clear evidence of an unusual accuracy advantage on potentially contaminated items.
blocks.zh:
与参考文献相比,记录受污染物品的模型的得分将高于清洁物品(表25)。 拉腊 迷你碱基没有:在MMLU上的区别是−0.2-0.2分(参考:−0.7-0.7至+2.0+2.0),在MBPP上的区别是−9.2-9.2分(−15.6-15.6至−8.4-8.4).
这两种差异都属于参考模型的范围,没有提供明确证据证明潜在污染物品具有不寻常的准确性优势。

blocks.en:
Memorization can also make the reference text more predictable without changing the answer.
This shows in the bits per byte (BPB) of the reference text given the prompt: the reference code for MBPP, the question and its correct answer for MMLU.
BPB varies across models, so only the ratio of contaminated to clean items is comparable; it is below 1 even for a model that has never seen the items, because the two groups differ in length and style.
The ratio of Lara Mini base lies within the reference ranges on both benchmarks ( Table 26 ): 0.982 on MMLU (0.940 to 0.990) and 0.763 on MBPP (0.749 to 0.806).
Thus, Lara Mini base does not exhibit an unusually large likelihood advantage on potentially contaminated items relative to the reference models.

此处以引用文本的比特/字节( BPB) 显示: MBPP 的参考代码, MMLU 的疑问和正确答案 。

Lara Mini基数在这两个基准的参考范围内(表26):MMLU0.982(0.940至0.990)和MBPP0.763(0.749至0.806)。
因此,拉腊 相对于参考模型而言,迷你碱对可能受污染的物品没有异常大的优势。

blocks.en:
HellaSwag draws its documents from ActivityNet Captions ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) and wikiHow 4 4 4 https://www.wikihow.com .
Each document contains an activity label, a context and four candidate endings.
The task is to choose the ending that best continues the context ( Figure 13 (a)).
The translated document must retain one context shared by all four endings, and each translated ending must remain consistent with that context.
We translated each document in four requests, one per ending.
Each request sent the activity label, context and ending as separate segments ( Figure 13 (b)).
The first request translated all three segments; requests 2 to 4 resent the translated activity label and context as non-translatable segments.
For ActivityNet documents, HellaSwag splits a sentence into context and endings: the context ends with the subject, most often a short phrase such as “he” or “the man”.
A subject cut off from its verb often cannot be translated correctly because, in many languages, the verb determines its case or position, or allows it to be dropped.
We therefore moved this subject fragment to the start of each ending before translation.
To keep activity labels consistent across documents, we also maintained a lexicon of them for each language.
Each label was translated once, and subsequent requests sent its translation as a non-translatable segment.
After translation, we restored wikiHow markup, such as [title] , using a rule-based script in the fields where Lara had translated.
We used Claude Opus 5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) to correct four types of translation error: fields in the wrong language or script; characters or words of another script within a field; English text left untranslated within a field; and two endings in the same document with identical translations.
blocks.zh:
HelaSwag 从活动提取文件 Net Captions (Krishna et al., 2017) and wikiHow 4 4 https://www.wikihow.com. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-03-02.
每份文件包含活动标签,上下文和四个候选结局.
任务是选择最好延续上下文的结局(图13(a))。
翻译后的文件必须保留所有四个结局所共有的上下文,每个译后必须始终与上下文保持一致。
我们把每份文件翻译成四个请求,每个结尾一个。
每一份请求将活动标签、上下文和结尾作为单独的部分发送(图13(b))。
第一个请求翻译了所有三个部分;请求2至4对翻译的活动标签和上下文表示不满,认为它们是非透明部分。
为活动 网易文件,HelaSwag将一句话分为上下文和结尾:上下文以主题结尾,最常是“他”或“此人”等短句。
与动词断绝关系的主题往往无法正确翻译,因为在许多语言中,动词决定其大小写或位置,或者允许将其丢弃.
因此,我们在翻译之前将这个议题的片断移到每个结束的开始。
为了保持文件之间活动标签的一致性,我们还为每种语文保留了一套词汇。
每个标签被翻译过一次,随后的请求将其翻译为不可翻译的部分.
在翻译后,我们恢复了维基How标记,如[标题],在Lara翻译过的字段使用一个基于规则的脚本.
我们用克劳德·奥普斯5.5(英语:Anthropic, 2026)来校正四种类型的翻译错误:错误语言或脚本中的字段;一个字段内另一个脚本的字符或单词;一个字段内未翻译的英文文本;以及同一文件中有相同译文的两个结尾.

blocks.en:
For each language variant, we selected the 200 documents with the highest translation-quality scores, stratifying the selection by source and by the difficulty of the English originals ( Figure 14 ).
We evaluated eight reference-free quality estimation (QE) models in each language variant to assess how reliably they ranked translations: CometKiwi-22 ( Rei et al., 2022 ) , CometKiwi-XL and CometKiwi-XXL ( Rei et al., 2023 ) , xCOMET-XL and xCOMET-XXL ( Guerreiro et al., 2024 ) , MetricX-24-Hybrid-XXL ( Juraska et al., 2024 ) , BLASER 2.0-QE ( Dale and Costa-jussà, 2024 ) , and COMET-poly ( Züfle et al., 2025 ) .
We tested each model on 1,000 sampled documents per language variant with four corruptions of an ending: word deletion, word shuffling, replacement with another ending of the same document and replacement with an ending of another document.
A model passed for a language if, for each corruption, it scored the original ending above the corrupted one in at least 95% of the comparisons.
Six of the eight models passed in at least one language.
In the three languages where no model passed, we used MetricX-24 alone with lower thresholds: 90% for Luxembourgish and Luganda, and 85% for West Central Oromo.
The models that passed for a language scored all four endings of every document.
Because a single faulty ending invalidates a document, each model rated a document by the percentile rank of its worst ending, and a document’s score was the mean of these ranks over the models that passed.
blocks.zh:
对于每种语言的变体,我们选择了翻译质量分数最高的200份文件,按照来源和英文原件的难度划分了选择范围(图14)。
我们评价了每个语言变体的8个无参考质量估计模型,以评估它们如何可靠地排列翻译: 彗星Kiwi-22(Rei等人,2022年),彗星Kiwi-XL和彗星Kiwi-XXL (Rei等人,2023年),xCOMET-XL和xCOMET-XXL(Guerreiro等人,2024年),MetricX-24-Hybrid-XXL (Juraska等人,2024年),BLASER 2.0-QE(Dale和Costa-jussà,2024年),和COMET-poly(Züfle等人,2025年).
我们测试了每个语言变体上1000个样本文件的每个模型,结果有四种腐败:删除字、打字、用同一文件的另一端替换和用另一端文件替换。
如果每一次腐败中,一个模型在至少95%的比较中得分高于腐败的原末。
8个模型中有6个至少用一种语言通过.
在没有模型经过的三种语言中,我们仅使用MetricX-24,阈值较低:90%用于卢森堡语和卢甘达语,85%用于中西部奥罗莫语。
为一种语言通过的模型对每个文档的所有四个结局都进行了评分.
因为一个错误的结局会使文件失效,所以每个模型都以文件最糟糕结局的百分位等级来评分文件,而文件的分数是这些等级相对于所通过模型的平均值。

blocks.en:
Before selection, automatic checks excluded documents containing untranslated English, fields in the wrong script or language ( Kargaran et al., 2023 ) , or retranslated fields.
Selecting by translation quality alone under-represented ActivityNet: its share of the selected documents fell from 32.4% to 15.0% on average.
Such a selection would therefore distort both the source and the difficulty distributions of the dataset.
We divided the remaining documents into 13 strata by source (ActivityNet or wikiHow) and by the difficulty of the English original, estimated with 50 public base models.
We selected the same proportion of the highest-scoring documents from each stratum, yielding 200 documents per language variant.
To verify that the difficulty was preserved, we evaluated 35 additional public base models, not used to build the strata, on the selected documents.
The mean absolute difference in English accuracy between the selected documents and the original split was 1.6 points, against 3.2 points when selecting by quality alone and 1.5 points for random documents from the same strata.
Each language variant has its own selection of documents, so part of a score difference between two variants comes from the documents.
T-HellaSwag is built to compare models within each variant.
blocks.zh:
在选择之前,自动检查包含未翻译英文的文档、错误的文字或语言字段(Kargaran等人,2023年),或重新翻译字段。
仅凭翻译质量就选择了代表不足的活动网:在所选文件中所占比例平均从32.4%下降到15.0%。
因此,这种选择将扭曲数据集的来源和困难分布。
我们按来源(ActivityNet或wikiHow)和英文原版难度, 将其余文件分为13个层次,
我们从每个层次中选择了同样比例的得分最高的文件,每个语言变体产生200份文件。
为了核实这一困难是否得以保留,我们评估了在选定的文件中另外35个公共基础模型,这些模型不是用来建立层层的。
在英文准确度方面,所选文档与原分数之间的平均绝对差为1.6分,而仅按质量选择的则为3.2分,从同一层随机选择的文档则为1.5分。
每个语言变体都有自己的文档选择,因此两个变体之间的分数差的一部分来自文档.
T -Hella (英语). Swag是用来比较每个变体内的模型的.

blocks.en:
Automatic checks verified that every translated document was complete and that the four endings of each document shared the same translated activity label and context.
On the final data, every check passed in both sets and in all 110 language variants.
We compared T-HellaSwag with Multilingual HellaSwag ( Lai et al., 2023 ) .
The latter’s construction differs from ours in two ways.
It keeps the activity labels in English, so that each of its prompts begins with English text.
It also translates the subject that ends each ActivityNet context separately from the endings, so that the two parts of the split sentence may not agree.
For each of the 32 languages in both datasets, we drew 50 random T-HellaSwag documents that Multilingual HellaSwag also translates, and compared the two translations of each document.
Two LLM judges, Gemini 4 Argon ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and Claude Opus 5.5, preferred our translation for 98.6% and 98.7% of the documents, respectively.
A human linguist reviewed 50 documents in each of Italian, French and Russian.
Of the 150 documents, 145 were rated OK, 5 as having a minor error and none as having a major error.
blocks.zh:
自动检查可以核实每个翻译的文档是完整的,每个文档的四个结尾共享相同的翻译活动标签和上下文.
在最终数据上,每张支票都通过两套和所有110种语言变体.
我们把T-HellaSwag与多种语言HelaSwag(Lai等人,2023年)进行比较。
后者的建筑在两个方面与我们不同。
它将活动标签保留在英文中,使其每个提示都以英文文本开头.
它还翻译了将每个活动网上下文与结尾分开结束的主题,这样分裂句的两个部分可能无法达成一致.
对于两个数据集中的32种语言,我们绘制了50个随机的T-HellaSwag文件,多语种HelaSwag也翻译这些文件,并比较了每个文件的两种翻译.
两位LLM评委,双子座4 Argon(Google DeepMind,2026年)和克劳德·奥普斯·5.5,分别选择了98.6%和98.7%的文件的翻译.
一名人类语言学家审查了意大利语,法语和俄语各50份文件.
在150份文件中,145份被评为 " 确定 " ,5份被评为小错误,没有一份被评为重大错误。

blocks.en:
Apart from the linguist review in three languages, the evidence of translation quality comes from QE models and LLM judges.
No human translator revised either set, so both can contain machine-translation errors, such as stray characters and line breaks.
T-HellaSwag-full is not filtered: it also keeps the documents that the automatic checks excluded from T-HellaSwag.
Both sets retain the situations described in the English source, so they measure commonsense reasoning in each language variant, not knowledge specific to its culture.
Because HellaSwag is public, a model that encountered an English document during training may recognize its translation.
blocks.zh:
除了三种语言的语言学评论,翻译质量的证据来自QE模型和LLM评委.
没有任何人文翻译器修改过任何一套,因此两者都可能包含机器翻译错误,如流浪字符和换行符.
T -Hella (英语). Swag-full没有过滤:它也保留了T-HellaSwag中不包括的自动检查的文档.
两套都保留了英语源描述的情况,因此它们测量每种语言变体中的常识推理,而不是其文化特有的知识.
因为赫拉 Swag是公开的,在培训中遇到英文文件的模型可能认可其翻译。

blocks.en:
Both sets will be released with one configuration per set and language variant, e.g., it-IT and it-IT-full for Italian.
They share 50 few-shot documents per language variant from the HellaSwag training split, so that no validation document serves as a few-shot example.
We translated the few-shot documents in the same way as the validation documents and selected them based on the scores from the same QE models.
We score each language variant in the same way as the standard HellaSwag task scores English.
The release will credit HellaSwag, wikiHow and ActivityNet Captions ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) as sources.
blocks.zh:
两套将发布每集一个配置和语言变体,例如意大利语的It-IT和It-It-full.
他们共享HelaSwag训练分裂中每个语言变体的50个几发文件,因此没有验证文件作为几个几发的例子.
我们以与验证文件相同的方式翻译了数发文件,并根据同一QE模型的分数来选择.
我们以与标准HelaSwag任务分英语相同的方式对每种语言变体进行评分.
该发布会将HelaSwag,wikiHow和ActiveNet Captions(Krishna等人,2017)作为来源.
